meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 把 Discord 机器人接入现有服务:从 channels 分支复制 Discord 适配器并注册、安装依赖包、跑注册测试,再引导你创建机器人、填入 Bot Token、重启服务并算出私聊频道 ID。
howto.when: 当你要求给服务加上 Discord 机器人渠道时触发,例如在 /setup 流程里接入渠道,或说要用 Discord 聊天。整个过程可重复执行。

say.text: 帮我把 Discord 机器人接入,我来创建应用和填 Bot Token。
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并重启服务。

say.text: 跑一下 discord 注册测试,看适配器装好没有。
say.note: 失败说明要重跑 Apply 里的步骤。

say.text: Discord 机器人在线但不回我消息,帮我排查。

howto.what_en: Adds Discord bot support: copies the Discord adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/discord, runs the registration test, then guides bot creation, credentials, restart, and your DM channel id.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Discord bot channel to the service, such as during the /setup flow. The whole skill is safe to re-run.

say_en.text: Add the Discord bot channel — I'll create the app and paste the Bot Token.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, restarts the service.

say_en.text: Run the Discord registration test to check the adapter install.
say_en.note: Red means re-run the Apply steps.

say_en.text: My Discord bot is online but never answers my messages.
say_en.note: Checks Message Content Intent and shared server.
